authority.menu_path: 右键 → 工具 → 书签同步
authority.room_id: SHA-256 hex of remote key UTF-8 bytes
authority.cipher: AES-256-GCM; key = SHA-256(remote_key UTF-8); payload base64 ciphertext+tag with 12-byte nonce prefix
authority.relay_persistence: bookmark-rooms.json only; rooms hold room_id, verifier, ciphertext, revision; never routes.json

invariants: Only bookmarks sync. History, passwords, cookies, extensions, and open tabs are out of scope.
Canonical URL identity: scheme and host lowercased, default ports stripped, trailing slash on path removed; query and fragment kept as-is.
One canonical URL yields one ledger entry across all browsers and Macs in the sync domain.
Initial merge and late join are union: unique URLs are kept; absence on one side never deletes.
After a browser or Mac has joined, deletes leave tombstones so old copies cannot revive them.
Remote key plaintext never leaves Mac Keychain except into encrypt/decrypt and verifier derivation in memory.
Relay stores only opaque ciphertext and never learns URLs or the remote key.
Writes carry expected_revision; stale revision is rejected and the client must pull, merge, and retry.
Bookmark rooms do not use device tokens and do not write remote-control routes.
prohibited_results: Persisting remote key plaintext, verifier, ciphertext, or URLs in routes.json or diagnostic logs.
Deleting a ledger URL solely because a newly joined browser lacks it.
Syncing passwords, cookies, history, extensions, or tabs through this channel.
Accepting a PUT with wrong verifier or stale expected_revision.
